items: 【Android 16 Tablet】Unlock a new level of efficiency with this tablet, powered by the latest Android 16 system featuring enhanced privacy controls. Driven by the Allwinner A333 penta-core processor, it delivers fast, stable performance and smoother multitasking for all your work and entertainment

【Ample 20GB RAM + Expandable Storage】​ Our Android tablet PC features 20GB of RAM (3GB+17GB) and 32GB of internal storage, expandable to 1TB via microSD card (sold separately). This 10-inch​ tablet offers ample memory and storage, making it convenient to store photos and videos, as well as install software that requires significant space

【10.1-inch IPS Display】​ This tablet features a​ 10.1-inch IPS display with 1280x800 resolution, high touch sensitivity, offering wide viewing angles and vibrant colors for comfortable video watching, web browsing, and reading. With Widevine L1 certification, it delivers true HD streaming on popular platforms for an immersive viewing experience

【Dual-Band Wi-Fi 6 & Long-Lasting Battery】Stay connected with advanced Wi-Fi 6 (2.4 GHz/5 GHz) and Bluetooth 5.4 for faster speeds and stable signals. A 6000mAh battery supports up to 6 hours of continuous video playback. The battery supports extended use for travel, entertainment, and more

【2-in-1 Tablet with Keyboard for Multi-occasion Use】This complete Android tablet with keyboard bundle includes 10.1-inch pink tablet, keyboard, mouse, stylus, protective case, USB-C cable, tablet stand, pre-installed screen protector, and user manual. Easily switch between tablet and laptop mode for work, study, and entertainment—a perfect, gift-ready portable solution. (All protective cases are gray; the color option refers to the tablet's back panel.)
